# ManifestHub — The Open Steam Manifest & Lua Registry

> ManifestHub is the central open-source dataset and Git repository for ManiLuaHub.com. It stores dedicated per-AppID branches containing verified Steam manifest Lua routing scripts and key.vdf depot decryption keys for 62,288 games.

## Core Resources

- **Official Web Registry**: https://maniluahub.com
- **Explore 62k Manifests**: https://maniluahub.com/explore
- **OpenAPI Documentation**: https://maniluahub.com/docs
- **Client Installation Guide**: https://maniluahub.com/how-to-use
- **Frequently Asked Questions**: https://maniluahub.com/faq
- **Client Download Hub**: https://maniluahub.com/download

## Data Flow & Architecture

1. **Branch-per-AppID Storage**:
   - Branch: `origin/<appId>`
   - Files: `<appId>.lua` and `key.vdf`
2. **Fastly Raw CDN Streaming**:
   - `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maniluahub/ManifestHub/<appId>/<appId>.lua`
   - `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maniluahub/ManifestHub/<appId>/key.vdf`
3. **Public REST APIs**:
   - Search: `GET https://maniluahub.com/api/search?q={query}`
   - Lua Script: `GET https://maniluahub.com/api/files/{appId}/lua`
   - ZIP Package: `GET https://maniluahub.com/api/files/{appId}/zip`
